title: Optional exact-source Field Kit artifact in the existing Company candidate job
scope: Two files only. Source proposal retained for independent review; no source branch, dispatch, generator, application or functional test execution.

controls: manual-only default-off exact-source selection with unchanged two-job topology and read-only permissions
valid source/run artifact hashes and refusal to overwrite an existing binding
thirteen source, run, repository and declared-output mismatch controls
verification.lintScope: RAM ESLint core no-undef (typeof true), no-unreachable and no-unused-vars with nodeBuiltin globals; no repository modules loaded.

boundaries.automaticBehavior: Original workflow bytes are unchanged after removing the two inputs and two steps. Existing optional-practice and Company jobs, source tests, release policy and public-media checks retained.
boundaries.inputs: Expected source is passed as an environment value, checked as lowercase forty-hex and matched against GITHUB_SHA, github.workflow_sha and checkout HEAD. No arbitrary source checkout is added.
boundaries.artifact: At most 512 files, 64 MiB per file, 128 MiB total and a 2 MiB review receipt. Only candidate ledger and compiled flat/assets paths accepted. Streamed byte hashes and actual inventory must match the isolated producer receipt. Binding is outside candidate and uses exclusive creation.
boundaries.budgets: Existing 60-minute Company job unchanged; added generation/reproduction step max 15 minutes, each generator process 300 seconds plus 30-second termination, upload max 5 minutes; artifact retention 14 days.
boundaries.authority: Technical candidate only. No --write, adoption, release/device/native approval, workflow downloads, new jobs or elevated contents permissions. No frozen approved hash/history change.
boundaries.followup: After independent source review and hosted tests, the selected manual-dispatch ref must itself contain this route and the intended body-backing source. If a ref advances after source_sha selection, it fails closed. Metadata continuation/adoption remains separately reviewed future work.

existingOutputSizing.source: Fixed-base committed Field Kit ledger and compiled tree; not a generator measurement.

limitations: Authored controls remain unexecuted until hosted CI.
Existing Company job runs its normal checks and edition builds before optional route; choose a valid small editions selection for a bounded manual qualification.
A successful candidate artifact is not metadata adoption, original/native raster evidence, or physical-device performance qualification.
